[[Irontooth Drake]]s are found in swampy areas, mostly on their own in the earlier areas. The later areas see several of them grouped together. In the [[Plains of Jarin]], two of them are usually found by many small groups of [[Juvenile Bladed Termite]]s; they are not grouped together and the [[insect]]s can be pulled and killed without attracting the drake.
